name: Conduit
author: E. T. Carter
description: Walking down a winding lava tube: a floor of ember-dark crust plates, crazed with fine cracks and split by white-hot mint seams, drifts underfoot, while the lumpy basalt arches overhead catch a cool rim of melt light on every edge, low benches line the walls and the far bend dissolves into glowing fume with sparks lifting through it.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the crust drifts and the walk moves down the tube.

params.label: Heat
params.effect: Brightness of the molten seams and the light they throw onto the walls.

params.label: Sparks
params.effect: How many sparks lift off the flow and how bright they are.

params.label: Fume
params.effect: Density of the lit fume that fills the tube and hides the far bend.
